messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
['For your protection, Online Banking has been locked because the number of attempts to sign in exceeded the number allowed.', 'This is to let you know that there are some suspicious activities going on in you account.', 'This e-mail has been sent to you by Scotiabank to inform you that we were unable to verify your details.', 'I have been diagnosed with Esophageal cancer which was discovered very late, due to my laxity uncaring for my health.', 'We recently reviewed your account, and suspected that your Tesco account might have been accessed by an unauthorized third party.', 'Your account is suspended due to the number of incorrect login attempts.', 'Online access to your account has been suspended.', 'The 119.00 GBP Exchequer payment you made to cmurchie@ntlworld.com has cleared.', 'During our regularly scheduled account maintenance and verification procedures, we have detected a slight error in your billing information.', 'your two incoming mails were placed on pending status due to the recent upgrade to our database', 'Yahoo Mail has discovered series of illegal attempts on your Yahoo Account from bad IP Location and will shut your account as it has been flagged as a spam account.', 'Unfortunately, when we tried to automatically upgrade your account it was not successful,', 'Abbey Customer Service would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Abbey Security software.', 'New Service Pack v6.7.8 update is ready for download.', 'Your mailbox has reached 980\xa0MB.', 'For security reasons, we have temporarily suspended your account and your access to online banking and will be restricted if you fail to update.', 'During a recent screening, we noticed an issue regarding your account.', 'Our record indicates that you recently made a request to shut down your email and this request will be processed shortly.', 'Your account is suspended due to the number of incorrect login attempts.', 'This is to inform you that we have sent your first payment of $5,000.00 (Five Thousand dollars) through Money Gram', 'Due to some issues we hold against your account(s), we temporarily suspended access to your online use.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
